title: Schützt die Heimat!
historicalContext: [NEEDS REVIEW] 1 print (poster) : lithograph, color ; 89 x 69 cm. | Poster shows a village in flames with a large claw-like hand formed out of smoke posed over the buildings. Text encourages people to protect the homeland by signing up for the volunteer corps of Generalkommando Lüttwitz or the  Eastern Border Protection Corps.
explanation: [NEEDS REVIEW] This piece uses fear appeals to motivate action by highlighting dangers and threats.
